sources.title: The Weak Gravity Conjecture and the Axionic Black Hole Paradox

evidence.text: Can a perturbatively massless 2-form have parametrically small coupling f without light charged strings or a low cutoff? The paper seeks a physical obstruction from axionic black-hole evaporation rather than assumptions about extremal black strings or gravitational instantons.

sources.title: A Semiclassical, Entropic Proof of a Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Can the generalized second law distinguish a consistent charged-scalar theory from an inconsistent one using only its macroscopic fields on a semiclassical black-hole background?

sources.title: Holographic Dual of The Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: What constraints do cosmic censorship and its proposed WGC modification impose holographically on boundary matter, especially the number of colours Nc, and could these constraints obstruct realistic QCD models?

sources.title: The weak gravity conjecture requires the existence of exotic AdS black holes

evidence.text: If a classically extremal AdS4–Kerr–Newman black hole stable against superradiance decays through smaller black holes, what restrictions follow for the daughters' specific angular momenta, horizons and compatibility with classical Cosmic Censorship?

sources.title: WGC and WCCC of black holes with quintessence and cloud strings in RPS space

evidence.text: Can RN-AdS black holes surrounded by quintessence and a string cloud satisfy the paper's weak-gravity charge-to-mass criterion while retaining a horizon at a restricted-phase-space thermodynamic critical point?

sources.title: Cosmic-quantum connections: Assessing the viability of weak gravity and weak cosmic censorship conjectures in Kerr-Newman-Kiselev-Letelier black hole

evidence.text: Can spin, a string cloud, and a quintessence term permit horizon-bearing extremal Kerr–Newman–Kiselev–Letelier configurations with Q²/M²>1, which the authors interpret as compatible with both the mild weak gravity conjecture and weak cosmic censorship?

sources.title: WGC and WCC for charged black holes with quintessence and cloud of strings

evidence.text: Under what restrictions can charged black holes surrounded by quintessence, with or without a cloud of strings, retain horizons when Q>M? The paper interprets these configurations as compatibility between its black-hole implementation of WGC and weak cosmic censorship.

sources.title: Weak cosmic censorship and weak gravity conjectures in CFT thermodynamics

evidence.text: Under which critical-point parameter conditions can the authors' WGC charge-to-mass criterion coexist with a horizon-based WCCC criterion for RN-AdS black holes surrounded by perfect fluid dark matter, using EPST, RPST and boundary CFT thermodynamics?

sources.title: Reissner-Nordström black holes surrounded by perfect fluid dark matter: Testing the viability of weak gravity conjecture and weak cosmic censorship conjecture simultaneously

evidence.text: Can PFDM modify the horizon and extremality conditions of an asymptotically flat RN configuration so that Q > M remains compatible with the authors' Mild WGC criterion and with a singularity hidden behind a horizon?

sources.title: Weak gravity conjecture validation with photon spheres of quantum corrected Reissner–Nordstrom–AdS black holes in Kiselev spacetime

evidence.text: Which parameter choices let the studied quantum-corrected charged AdS geometries retain an event horizon and an unstable photon sphere when Q > M, and can this coexistence support the authors’ proposed WGC/WCCC compatibility diagnostic?

sources.title: Reconciling the Weak Gravity and Weak Cosmic Censorship Conjectures in Einstein-Euler-Heisenberg-AdS Black Holes

evidence.text: Can electromagnetic nonlinearities produce Einstein–Euler–Heisenberg–AdS configurations with Qe>Me that retain horizons while satisfying the authors' particle charge-to-mass criterion for the WGC, and do photon-sphere diagnostics support the same parameter choices?

sources.title: Weak gravity conjecture in ModMax black holes: weak cosmic censorship and photon sphere analysis

evidence.text: Can ModMax black holes retain horizons and unstable photon spheres when their charge exceeds the RN reference bound Q/M=1, and how do an AdS radius and constant-curvature F(R) corrections affect the authors' proposed WGC–WCCC compatibility?

sources.title: The Weak Gravity Conjecture and the Axionic Black Hole Paradox

evidence.text: A qualitative reduction of the exterior 2-form action to its radial zero mode gives S ∼ ∫dt (∂t b)²/(f² R). Wave-packet spreading then estimates the time over which localized b can be treated classically.

sources.title: A Semiclassical, Entropic Proof of a Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Subtract divergences with local operators, match a selected background to prescribed classical values, and compare nearby backgrounds without retuning the theory. The paper uses this to keep the initial black hole semiclassical despite a large proposed logarithmic coefficient.

sources.title: Holographic Dual of The Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: For emission of a particle with positive charge q and mass m, the author combines an energy inequality with the requirement that the remnant remain below the extremality curve. This gives the local condition q/m > dQ*/dM*, with M*=M/L^2 and Q*=Q/L^2.

sources.title: The weak gravity conjecture requires the existence of exotic AdS black holes

evidence.text: Set the Hawking temperature to zero to obtain the extremal horizon radius, then impose the radial horizon equation to express the classical censorship bound in physical mass and charge. Analyze the resulting extremality surface and its derivatives.

sources.title: WGC and WCCC of black holes with quintessence and cloud strings in RPS space

evidence.text: Solve f(r+)=0 for M, use S=πr+²/G and T=f′(r+)/4π, and rewrite M as a function of S,Q,C,b,α. Thermodynamic conjugates are then obtained through partial derivatives.

sources.title: WGC and WCC for charged black holes with quintessence and cloud of strings

evidence.text: Extremality is obtained by simultaneous equality and tangency of the two curves, equivalently the double-root/zero-temperature condition. The authors derive critical normalizations ce and use small-c, or joint small-b and small-c, expansions of extremal charge-to-mass ratios.

sources.title: Constraints on high-order gravitational theories from weak cosmic censorship

evidence.text: Can imposing weak cosmic censorship as a classical admissibility principle constrain higher-curvature gravitational theories, using first-order accretion experiments and a condition computable from extremal near-horizon data?

sources.title: Scalar lumps with two horizons

evidence.text: What global geometries and existence limits arise for static, spherically symmetric scalar lumps with two horizons, and can their Euclidean continuations be smoothly attached to an exterior vacuum spacetime for black hole seeded decay?

sources.title: Constraints on Low-Energy Effective Theories from Weak Cosmic Censorship

evidence.text: Can weak cosmic censorship constrain higher-derivative Einstein-Maxwell EFT coefficients through attempts to overcharge an initially extremal, nonrotating black hole with infalling charged matter?

sources.title: Further evidence for the weak gravity — cosmic censorship connection

evidence.text: Does charged matter satisfying the appropriately modified weak gravity bound remove the boundary-driven AdS counterexamples to weak cosmic censorship when a dilaton or a second Maxwell field is added, and is that bound necessary?

sources.title: Weak gravity conjecture from conformal field theory: a challenge from hyperscaling violating and Kerr-Newman-AdS black holes

evidence.text: Can charged-scalar CFT correlation functions and their relaxation poles imply weak gravity conjecture conditions for hyperscaling violating (HSV) and Kerr-Newman-AdS (KNA) black holes, particularly near extremality?

sources.title: Tachyon condensation and black strings

evidence.text: Can winding-tachyon condensation outside a charged black-string horizon replace the horizon with a charged Kaluza-Klein bubble before string-scale curvature is reached, and when is the resulting bubble static or expanding?

sources.title: Testing the Weak Gravity - Cosmic Censorship Connection

evidence.text: Does adding a sufficiently charged scalar remove the proposed electrically driven AdS4 counterexamples to weak cosmic censorship, and does the minimum charge needed for regular endpoints coincide with the proposed AdS weak-gravity bound?

sources.title: A Semiclassical, Entropic Proof of a Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: The background permits a semiclassical test of a charged scalar whose mass is too large to discharge an extremal black hole along a chosen charge direction. A large radius suppresses curvature while the charge projection q·Q can remain large.

sources.title: Violation of Weak Cosmic Censorship in Einstein-Maxwell-dilaton theory: singularities connected by traversable wormholes

evidence.text: Can analytic Einstein-Maxwell-dilaton solutions furnish positive-mass naked singularities, singularity pairs with a traversable connection, and a nonsingular dyonic limit? What charges, weak-gravity diagnostic and light deflection follow?

sources.title: Strong cosmic censorship in light of weak gravity conjecture for charged black holes

evidence.text: Can the electric weak gravity conjecture ensure strong cosmic censorship for charged de Sitter black holes perturbed by a massive charged scalar, as diagnosed through quasinormal decay relative to Cauchy-horizon blueshift?

sources.title: Analyzing WGC and WCCC through charged scalar fields fluxes with charged AdS black holes surrounded by perfect fluid dark matter in the CFT thermodynamics

evidence.text: Can charged-scalar absorption and superradiant emission preserve weak cosmic censorship while supporting the weak gravity conjecture for RN–AdS black holes surrounded by perfect fluid dark matter, within holographic CFT thermodynamics?

sources.title: dS$_{4}$ universe emergent from Kerr-AdS$_{5}$ spacetime: bubble nucleation catalyzed by a black hole

evidence.text: Can a vacuum bubble nucleated around a rotating AdS5 black hole support quasi-dS4 cosmology, and how do rotation, black-hole regularity and competing superradiance constrain nucleation and its rate?

sources.title: New bubble decays in Kaluza-Klein theories

evidence.text: Does analytic continuation of a Kaluza–Klein electrically charged black hole describe a vacuum decay, and how does torus tilt affect its bubble nucleation exponent?

sources.title: Black Holes Inside and Out 2024: visions for the future of black hole physics

evidence.text: What theoretical developments and observations can clarify black hole stability, horizon structure, quantum evaporation, and departures from general relativity?

sources.title: Gravitational Waves from Black Hole Emission

evidence.text: What plausible gravitational-wave morphology would accompany emission of a small black hole by a larger one, with or without subsequent reabsorption, and can simple modifications of existing waveforms provide templates for future null tests of GR?

sources.title: Planar black holes as a route to understanding the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Can extremal or near-extremal black-hole decay satisfy the second law, and what mechanism causes instability? The paper studies these questions for five-dimensional charged black holes, emphasizing AdS solutions with flat toroidal or planar transverse sections.

sources.title: Compact objects and the swampland

evidence.text: Do conjectural quantum-gravity bounds distinguish stable scalar compact objects from unstable or ultracompact configurations? The paper tests spherical and rotating boson stars and synchronized hairy black holes, using light rings as the operational sign of ultracompactness.

evidence.text: Models fixed-winding strings by a scalar wave equation on the Schwarzschild bubble, using the weighted Klein-Gordon product, variational upper bounds and a comparison square-well potential for lower-frequency bounds.

sources.title: A Note on the Swampland Distance Conjecture

evidence.text: Normalize two object constraints to the same variable, compare their endpoints, and substitute model-specific scaling laws afterward. Here the black-hole mass is eliminated first, separating the species consistency bound from the assumed exponential field dependence.

sources.title: Cosmic Censorship of Trans-Planckian Field Ranges in Gravitational Collapse

evidence.text: Choose Gaussian, modified-Gaussian, ball/tanh, and shell initial profiles. Construct constraint-compatible initial geometric data using fourth-order Runge–Kutta; obtain the first time step through a second-order Taylor expansion or a single-step method.

sources.title: Young Black Holes Have Smooth Horizons: A Swampland Argument

evidence.text: Evaluate both Einstein constraints after every time step and stop when a chosen cutoff is exceeded. Restrict plotted regions and evolution times so errors from the extrapolated outer boundary have not reached the region of interest.

sources.title: Stringy forces in the black hole interior

evidence.text: Use an approximate string worldsheet action and oscillator expansion to argue that time-dependent couplings transfer infalling center-of-mass energy into excited string modes. This supplies a qualitative mechanism rather than computed occupation numbers.

sources.title: Black hole production in particle collisions and higher curvature gravity

evidence.text: A local colliding-plane-wave ansatz, neglect of transverse derivatives, and a small-first-gradient approximation reduce the field equations to Auu Avv − Auv² + λAuv = 0, with λ = (D−3)/[16(D−4)κ]. Cubic and higher Lovelock tensors vanish within this approximation through index antisymmetrization.
